response.justification: The candidate is an experienced senior full-stack engineer with a strong web, backend, and tooling background, but the profile does not align with the core requirements of this embedded security role. There is no Japanese language ability (a hard, native-level requirement), no demonstrated Linux kernel analysis or modification, and no networking (L2/L3, switch, MACsec, 802.1X, NETCONF/SNMP) or embedded security experience. C experience is limited and dated (National Instruments, 2014–2015), with recent work almost entirely in TypeScript/Node and DLang. Absent a relocation/language plan, this is not a viable fit.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software engineering experience across many domains
Some C/C++ exposure (NI LabWindows/CVI) and Linux/systems familiarity
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, tooling, open-source leadership
concerns: No Japanese proficiency; role requires native-level Japanese
No embedded firmware, switch, or L2/L3 networking security experience
No evidence of Linux kernel source analysis or modification; C skills dated

key_factors.factor: Lack of embedded networking/security domain experience
Limited/dated C and Linux kernel-level work
